title: Fix admin wallet balance showing as 0 PKR (persist admin wallet + improve error handling)

requirements.text: Persist the admin wallet balance in stable canister state so that it starts at 10,000 PKR on first install and does not reset to 0 (or reinitialize) after canister upgrades/redeployments.
acceptanceCriteria: After a fresh deploy, getAdminWalletBalance (as an admin) returns 10_000.
After an upgrade/redeploy that preserves state, getAdminWalletBalance returns the pre-upgrade value (not reset to 10_000 and not 0).
Admin-to-user distributions reduce the persisted admin wallet balance and the reduced value remains correct after a page refresh and after an upgrade.

requirements.text: Ensure the admin wallet does not become inaccessible due to missing admin initialization: the backend must reliably recognize the intended admin principal(s) so that admin-only methods (e.g., getAdminWalletBalance, getAllOrders, updateOrderStatus, distributeFunds) work for the admin account used by the app.
acceptanceCriteria: When signed in as an admin, the frontend can successfully call getAdminWalletBalance without an unauthorized trap.
When signed in as a non-admin, getAdminWalletBalance remains admin-only and is rejected by the backend.

requirements.text: Update the BalanceIndicator admin wallet display logic so it never misleadingly shows “0 PKR” when the admin wallet query fails or is unavailable; instead, show a clear English UI state (e.g., “Admin Wallet: Unavailable” or an error message) for admins, and continue to hide the admin wallet section for non-admin users without surfacing errors.
acceptanceCriteria: If getAdminWalletBalance errors for an authenticated admin user, BalanceIndicator does not render a numeric 0 as the admin wallet balance; it renders an English error/unavailable state.
If the viewer is not an admin, BalanceIndicator does not show an error state related to admin wallet access and simply omits the admin wallet portion.
If getAdminWalletBalance succeeds, BalanceIndicator shows the correct persisted admin wallet balance (formatted) and not 0.

requirements.text: Update the Admin page (/admin) wallet-balance card so that it reflects the real persisted admin wallet balance when available and shows a clear English message when the admin wallet balance is unavailable (instead of defaulting to 0).
acceptanceCriteria: When signed in as an admin, /admin displays the same correct admin wallet balance as returned by getAdminWalletBalance.
When the admin wallet balance cannot be loaded, /admin shows an English error/unavailable state and does not show 0 as a fallback value.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Generate backend/migration.mo only if needed to preserve existing deployed state (conditional migration policy).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutable frontend paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
All user-facing text must be in English.
nonGoals: Adding new payment methods or external database integrations.
Changing the currency away from PKR or changing package pricing/tiers.
